question: As of Dec 31, 2024, what was Warner Discovery's (NASDQ: WBD) Total Restructuring Costs incurred as a result of its 2022 Merger?

rubric.criteria: Warner Discovery's Total Restructuring Costs as of Dec 31, 2024, were $4.7 Billion

model_answer:
Content is short; fetch the 10-K.As of December 31, 2024, WBD had incurred about **$4.7 billion** in pre-tax restructuring charges tied to its April 2022 Merger with WarnerMedia. This comes from WBD's FY2024 Form 10-K. The filing says the company originally expected to incur roughly $4.1–$5.3 billion in these charges. It also says the Merger-related restructuring program was substantially completed at the end of 2024.

The $4.7 billion is a rounded cumulative figure. It covers the Merger program only. The annual "restructuring and other charges" in the 10-K ($3,757M in 2022, $585M in 2023 and $447M in 2024) also include unrelated initiatives, so they don't add up to $4.7 billion.
judge_reason: The model states $4.7 billion in cumulative Merger restructuring costs as of Dec 31, 2024, which matches the official answer.
